Of the Tidemark Tabby—her begetting, her blood, her very habits—the Felinian Chronicles make no record; and when I came to study her manner of living and the traces of her change, I found her far removed from every kind I had been wont to see.

For the Tidemark Tabby is a cat peculiar to the Steam Islands, and nowhere else to be found. Her nearest kin, it may be, are to be sought among the island breeds—the Kurilian Bobtail and the Manx Cat. Yet this kind is stranger than the rest: all are of the female sex, and never a male among them; and their way of increase runs counter to the common law of nature. For they conceive without union and bring forth without sire—wherefore the world hath named it the Cycle of Death and Rebirth.

Their eyes hold a mist, yet shimmer with many hues, their colour shifting as they are viewed from differing angles. Their ears, in their true form, are large and full; yet when they take on human seeming, they grow slender and narrow. Now and again one is found short of tail, but the most of them bear long tails, sinewy and strong.

O wondrous! This kind is graced with marvels beyond numbering—can she truly be a thing of mere chance beneath Heaven? Her markings are dappled as the breaking tide, and grand in their sweep as mountains and rivers; her claws keep yet a remnant of webbing, which, being spread, shows full and plain; her blue-grey coat takes the sun and deepens to rust... The "Tang Cat" refers to cats of Chinese origin, as opposed to Japan's native "Wa-neko."
When Tang Cats first came to Japan, they were cherished by the imperial court and later found their way into numerous works of literature. The Black Tang Cat is the most iconic among them. Sleek and graceful, it moves with a light, almost silent step. Its coat is smooth and glossy, appearing jet-black in shadow but taking on a warm reddish sheen in the sun.
Black Cats are said to appear in places touched by misfortune. With their gift for sensing approaching disaster and warding off ill fate, they have long been regarded as protective spirits. Yet in dim light, their resemblance to ordinary black cats has sometimes led people to mistake them for omens of bad luck. In truth, the Black Tang Cat is revered as a guardian and a bearer of blessings, especially for prosperity in business and luck in love. Its likeness can be found in ancient buildings, classical art, and folktales, where it endures as a quiet symbol of hope and the longing for a better life.

—Felinian Chronicles: Whispers of Ten Thousand Secrets

Within the remnants of the Ancient Felinian Civilizations, a blood-red feline reminiscent of the Abyssinian roams, leading many to believe it is a direct descendant of this enigmatic lineage. Abyssinian cats possess wedge-shaped faces and pointed ears that stand out prominently. Their almond-shaped eyes come in various colors, such as amber, light brown, or green, encircled by dark rings that mimic eyeliner. The defining feature of Abyssinian cats is their red-brown or red fur, which is fine, soft, and elastic. These graceful creatures sport a lightweight physique and elegant gaits, akin to dancers donning flowing skirts, making them a unique and rare breed among cats.
Abyssinian cats possess an alert and intelligent nature, bursting with boundless energy. They prefer a solitary existence and thrive in spacious environments where they can roam freely without constraints.

— Felinian Chronicles: Whispers of Ten Thousand Secrets

Ginger cats do not represent a specific breed, but rather a classification for all-orange or orange-white cats. Their origins remain elusive. Most ginger cats have short hair, although there are also long-haired varieties. The stripes on their fur resemble that of a tiger, hence their alternative name, tabby cats.
Ginger cats are typically lively and playful, thoroughly enjoying being pampered. They often have a tendency to put on weight due to their laid-back lifestyle and big appetite, hence the saying, "Nine out of ten ginger cats are fat."

— Felinian Chronicles: Whispers of Ten Thousand Secrets

Maine Coon cats have earned the nickname "gentle giants," owing to their large size and gentle temperament. In addition to their robust build, they possess thick bones, strong muscles, dense ear hair, and prominent tufts of long fur. Their striking green, golden, or copper-colored pupils resemble those of lions, adding to their wild and majestic appearance. Contrary to their imposing look, they are capable of producing bird-like chirping sounds, which are endearing.
These cats possess a naturally gentle disposition. Courageous and strong, they can withstand harsh weather conditions and excel at catching mice. Maine Coon cats are also intelligent and independent, valuing their quiet and secluded spaces for rest and alone time.

— Felinian Chronicles: Whispers of Ten Thousand Secrets

For her, this journey was not just about achieving professional excellence as a healer, but also an endless quest for atonement.\n"The sin that courses through my veins is my inescapable fate—a duty and burden I must bear."
There's no clear-cut divide between heaven and hell in this world.

Her family has staked everything on her coming to Catto City—it's a high-stakes gamble for the entire Akanuma family and Sakura Island.\nIf she fails to deliver, endure or achieve what's expected, it'll all be for nothing. Just like the elegant lotus in the pond needs fresh shoots to cover the muck, Akanuma Ren, as perfect as she is, is searching for the ideal partner to work with.\n"A marriage alliance? That's one way to see it. But I have already..."
Graceful and composed, always striving for perfection.
Do sinners like me still deserve salvation?

According to the Sacred Enlightenment, the gods love humanity, but not everyone is deemed worthy of that love.\nEven though Scarlett faithfully adheres to the rules of the Holy Order, praying daily with unwavering faith, the "sin" imprinted on her soul can never be cleansed—she is the forbidden offspring of a human and Felinian kind, and her birth directly resulted in her mother's death. This "sin" is like thorns, binding Scarlett and keeping her confined within the small church, until she no longer wishes to venture outside.\nOr perhaps she is just waiting for a "hero" to come and burn away the thorns, bringing her long-awaited peace.
My word is absolute; my decisions are beyond challenge.

"Emperor Jinque, known posthumously as 'Li (the Despotic),' ascended to the throne at the tender age of six and was said to have perished within a decade."
The sparse historical records fail to reveal the true fate of Emperor Li, Jinque. Along with the legendary treasures of the world, she was buried in the dust of history.
From that moment on, her legend became confined to the pages of ancient texts, forever labeled a "tyrant."
Yet, beneath the earth's surface, trapped within a tomb of solid gold, time loses all meaning.
A decade? A century? A millennium?
To Jinque, the passage of time is a blur.
What she knows for certain is that to this day, she has yet to fully explore the riches within her vault.
Irascible and indulgent, loyal to her own desires and beliefs.
Human hearts are inscrutable, while lies are easily woven.

Dreams are a tapestry of colors woven between day and night, the promised land of blurred reality and illusion. Qi is the arbiter traversing countless dreams.
The renowned tea house of mystery, and the even more elusive, phantasmal soul healers within, have left countless captivating imprints within the eerie urban legends that proclaim "evil begets evil."
But where do those fear-laden Pathos Particles go once we awaken from our dreams? The answer remains shrouded in uncertainty.

"Oh my, a guest has arrived. How can I possibly neglect them?"
Until this very day, the radiant light has drawn her favor—tonight, whose dreams will she venture into?
I don't feel like I need anything else... Just having you and everyone else in my life is enough for me.

Her floppy ears often catch curious eyes, while the mechanical skeleton supporting her frame might make some people keep their distance. However, Raphaella remains unfazed, always greeting everyone with a warm and inviting smile.\nNow, she dedicates herself to cooking, cleaning, and caring for the cats, using her petite size to protect the Stray Cat Shelter and those within it. Her actions speak volumes; despite the challenges she's faced, Raphaella finds happiness and contentment in the here and now. As long as she can help others, that's all that matters to her.\n"Welcome to the Stray Cat Shelter! How can I assist you today?"
Since greed knows no bounds, let it run wild and boundless.

"I am the blood relative of the Black King."
The unforgettable admonition from her parents before their passing was easily confirmed upon meeting the king.
Like an anchor, it keeps Sylviette's faltering heart locked in a position just one step away from the precipice.
Born and raised in desolate lands, she blossomed like an enchanting flower, with greed and ambition akin to an endless abyss, constantly absorbing everything in her vicinity.
To acquire everything, to control everything. The tremors and submission of others temporarily make her forget the unease festering deep within herself.
What does that unease signify? Sylviette doesn't want to contemplate it.
"Fear" has the power to shatter everything, doesn't it?
Aloof and melancholic, with ambition concealed within.

Since her earliest memories, Danica has grown accustomed to surviving in grimy, foul-smelling, and noisy alleyways.
Being an orphan meant having no one to depend on, and the icy glares and disdain from others had become all too familiar to her.

Yet, young Danica grew resilient nonetheless.
The conventional idea of happiness eluded her, and she believed herself to be different from everyone else in this world.

She cast aside notions of morality and loyalty, scorned wealth and status, and detested sympathy and handouts... as long as the darkness that was destined to accompany her throughout life allowed her to run and seek solace, everything else became meaningless chains.

"What? Emotions... aren't they the most useless thing?"
Unbound and unrestrained, a solitary drifter.

It is said that every Inspector who emerges from the rigorous training system of the StormEye bears an indelible psychological imprint left by the renowned instructor, "Moonred."
The strict teachings and the multitude of methods, create a striking contrast with the instructor's diminutive stature and adorable appearance.

"Listen to me attentively!"

After reprimanding others from a position of superiority, Evelina always quickly reflects on herself: Oops, perhaps I went a bit too far... Fortunately, no one truly holds a grudge against her for it.
Some suspect that she serves an incredibly mysterious force. But does this enigmatic entity truly exist in our world?
Enigmatic and perilous, aloof and dignified.
Even the faintest starlight can pierce the darkest night.

Most see Hildegard as cold and detached, consumed only by her research on Pathosis.
But those who truly observe her will glimpse the resolve and compassion hidden beneath her icy demeanor.
She knows the sting of loneliness too well—and she won't let it claim another soul.
So she walks alone into the abyss, facing every challenge head-on.
The world needs its starlight, after all.
The reserved scholar with OCD tendencies
In winter, the bare trees and plants sway under the falling snow, as if they've been reborn as spring blooms.

She was never the cherished child everyone expected.
From early childhood through her teenage years, she existed to meet the demands of her "father" and "keeper"—acting as a meal ticket, a watchful eye... always put to the best use.
Her own life?
Its value?
She has neither.
If there's anything she can strive for, it's beauty alone. So she greedily gazes upon the desperate avenger, the blazing crimson lotus, and... the one who remains pure white even in the darkness.
Elegant and otherworldly, with a gentle and humble nature.
My smile will illuminate your day!

In the gentle morning light, accompanied by the soft chime of the doorbell, Mandy's warm smile and the first rays of the sun on the horizon arrive as promised, illuminating the Baker's Cafe. However, when this pink, youthful figure looks at the manager, a hint of bashful blush always tinges on her smile... Does the manager still remember what happened in the past...?\nRegardless of whether the manager remembers or not, every morning Mandy will face the manager with her brightest smile!\n"Good morning, Manager! I'll cheer you on for today's work too!"
I hope to give you the strength to move forward.

Under the enduring love and affection of her parents, Felicia developed a pure, optimistic, and compassionate personality.
As she matured, her longing to explore the world grew stronger, yet she felt as though her parents' ever-increasing love was somehow impeding her progress. With an increasing yearning for independence, Felicia quietly saved up enough money to prepare for the forthcoming negotiation with her parents.
To her surprise, when she finally mustered the courage to confront them, she encountered no resistance. It became clear that her parents' love was not a chain holding her back, but rather a sail propelling her towards her journey of self-discovery.
Nowadays, Four Seasons resonates with heartfelt sentiments, boundless tenderness, and an aura of romance. This place has transformed into Felicia's dreamland.
My life, it goes on and on and on...\nScore, score, score!

Around the green field, countless spectators hold their breath, their gaze fixated on the dazzling presence on the field—Sunny.
Sweat flies as she runs, and the soccer ball soars across the grassy field—goal! It's in!
The screams and cheers erupting from the stands are enough to shake the entire venue.
"Miss Soccer," a precious rookie forward like a diamond, and a guaranteed spot in the All-Stars...
In the face of the overwhelming attention and praise, like a hurricane, she always wears a determined smile, never once feeling lost.
After all, these beautiful achievements were earned through days of arduous training! However, in the places where people cannot direct their gaze, the girl nervously cheers herself on:
"Phew... You can do it! Keep it up, Sunny!"
Cheerful and optimistic, resilient and persistent.
If I can protect this part of the world, let the world crumble—it matters not to me.

Born into a renowned antique family in Yaozhou, yet she spends her days indulging in her own collection at the small Antiquities Atrium.
Appearing carefree and easygoing on the surface, but secretly harboring a sense of pride; outwardly desiring nothing, yet possessed by an extraordinary passion for items that capture her interest. And by a twist of fate, this peculiar passion has become the subject of whispered rumors throughout Yaozhou.
She, however, pays no heed to such gossip.
In the eyes of some observers, though, this obsessive curiosity...
perhaps bears more resemblance to madness.
I yearn to possess every last belonging of my master as mine...

Love evaded her. She had none.
Forsaken by her parents as a child, or betrayed and taken advantage of in her aimless wanderings, Mink has always been the child with nothing.
This void drove her to desperately seek "love."
The impulse fueling Mink's every move is a raw, all-encompassing yearning to be affirmed, witnessed, enveloped, and revered.
She would surrender all that she owns for the opportunity to open her eyes each morning and find someone there, arms open wide in affection...solely for her.
Her, and her alone.
The moon is a wound in the night. Each star is like a drop of blood.

When distorting herself becomes a habit, when endless darkness becomes eternal, roses grow and bloom from the depths of Dorothy's heart, intertwining into a thorny graveyard. As the esteemed "Pope," she becomes obsessed with collecting beautiful things and transforming them into her treasures. Anything she cannot obtain, she destroys immediately, never allowing the next fortunate person to even graze it.\n"The flowers in the garden... they all bloom for me to pluck with my own hands."\nShe believes, unshaken in her conviction.
Dutiful and innocent, frail and endearing.
As money serves as a tangible emblem of achievement, we'll see how it goes!

As the inheritor of a commercial empire, the quandary of striking a balance between market recognition and personal principles forms the crux of Linn's existence.\nIndeed, the equilibrium of life is not solely swayed by material riches. It is, in essence, a clash of spirits between Linn and the heritage of her forebears. Following a setback in the family's business rivalry, she embarked on crafting her own legacy. Through the establishment of the Furrmeow Detectives and her role as an affiliate marketer at MeowBox Mall, she consistently seizes favorable opportunities, seeking to harmonize human connections with the pursuit of prosperity.\nEven in the face of occasional missteps, money stands as a mere instrument for Linn in her journey toward self-realization.
Vibrant and spirited, brimming with enthusiasm and warmth.
All sacrifices are for the greater future of our people.

Eleanor has been passionate about scientific research since she was a child. After graduating with top honors, she joined the Tower Research Institute. Following the Tower Incident that devastated many institutions, Eleanor emerged as the leader of the reformed Ivorus Institute and was elected Speaker by various factions. With her exceptional abilities, she skillfully navigates the complexities of power dynamics. Even under strict constraints, Eleanor maintains a poised and unwavering demeanor.\nOnce, Eleanor shared a close bond with Asura's parents. After their mysterious disappearance, she took Asura in without hesitation.\nHowever, Eleanor's warm, rational exterior masks a deep, shocking secret...
To deceive the eyes, one must first deceive the heart.

Trixie, the lone Felinian Inspector serving in Catto City,
took a different path than her fellow feline, Leona, who sought to challenge the restriction that only humans could be chiefs. Trixie assumed the role of an Inspector simply because nobody seemed to pay attention to the order on Castaway Island.
As her mentor advised, survival on the island necessitated mastering and manipulating its rules,
a skill that Trixie effortlessly acquired.
Craving excitement and victory, she often found herself on a losing streak, perhaps due to her moniker as the "Comet."
But worry not, when faced with adversity, Trixie would resort to cheating. And if cheating failed, she would adopt the guise of an undercover Inspector from the StormEye.
Wait, what do you mean by "assume”? Trixie is an Inspector! She truly is!
My march ever onward has never faltered.

The sea breeze tousles her hair, yet it never dulls her impossibly bright smile. Wherever she rushes like an unstoppable blue whirlwind, the very air around her seems to shimmer with energy.\nBut beneath this relentless cheerfulness lies a shield forged from the solitude of the vast ocean. The shipwreck that nearly took her life, along with the "salvation" and "lessons" imparted by "Love" in Wonderland, have blurred the lines between love and pain for her.\n"Still figuring it out... but quitting's not in my vocabulary!"
Vows should be upheld through actions, not just spoken words.

Fifi, orphaned by a maritime tragedy in her youth, lost her memory and has been living alone among the forests and shores of Castaway Island. She found a new family, only to be thrown into a conspiracy that dealt her a heavy blow.\nTo protect the innocent, Fifi faked her own death and began living in the wild in Cat Form. Despite facing monumental challenges, she remains resilient, quietly uncovering the truth while watching over her beloved family from afar.\nThough she appears self-sufficient, Fifi deeply values connections, yearns for community, and is unwaveringly devoted to her kin and companions. She possesses formidable strength, makes astute decisions in complex combat situations, excels in teamwork, and boasts exceptional wilderness survival skills.
Even if the future fades into oblivion, I will stand at the edge of time and space, searching for that final glimmer of light.

Fata hails from a distant galaxy, from a long-extinguished star.
On that planet, everything is within her grasp.
Yet, she cares little for this material world—her focus lies solely on the distant future.
"It remains shrouded, so I shall not gaze upon it!"
Fata dedicated herself to restoring the Ark, collecting unique Pathos along the way.
If I gather them all,
perhaps in my new homeland, a way forward will appear.
But where is that homeland?
Bearing the mission of the Original Felinians and the survival of the world, she sank into the folds of time and space, observing and deducting—
until at last, she discovered that radiant star.
A radiant gem, rare and shrouded in mystery.
You won't know the outcome until you take the leap, right?

In a story that began with scientific innovation, Garfire was created with the power to wield and control explosives. While the shadows of her past may have faded, they still leave a subtle scar, occasionally surfacing beneath her bright smile.\nYet, with an inherent zest for life, she breaks free from the chains of her origins, cultivating a vitality that is uniquely her own, grounded in sincerity and fueled by a fearless spirit.\nLike a wild spark, she thrives silently in the chill of darkness and the vast sea of wrongdoing.
Straightforward and cheerful, with a devil-may-care attitude.
We only have worth when we are recognized.

Aphros, an experimental breed created by the Divine Selection Bureau, was secretly freed by her parents shortly after birth. She drifted downriver until a kind soul took her in. However, her uniqueness destined her for a life filled with challenges. After years of hiding and disguising herself, she lost her sense of identity.\nTragedies haunted her existence. Stripped of family and bound by a curse, the girl fell into an endless sleep, waiting for her destined one to awaken her with a kiss.\nWhen the curse was finally broken, she was reborn in love... This time, she might discover her true self.
I will stand as your guardian of well-being!

Lily's past is a rich tapestry of memories, distant yet vividly etched in her mind. Though she may appear to be just another AI robot from Ivorus, there's a spark within her that sets her apart from mere machinery.\nAfter years spent alongside Sage, witnessing the fragility of life in the eyes of countless humans and Felinians during their final moments, Lily has shifted her focus to the well-being of those around her.\n"You've been stuck in that chair forever! How about we hit the trails for a five-kilometer run?"
Bubbly and pure-hearted, a cheerful little fool.
Beauty is a razor-sharp sword, a banner of inspiration, a bastion of defense, and my unique mark.

She's the star of the Elis Guild, a socialite wrapped in mystery as the manager of Elis Bar.
Regardless of the role she takes on, her distinctive style always shines through.
In the bustling social scene, surrounded by the clink of glasses and the buzz of conversation, she effortlessly wields her charm, weaving captivating words to ensnare her audience. With a sharp intellect and an independent spirit, she navigates the intricate web of influence and ambition.
Even as she navigates the murky waters of human emotions and aspirations, she remains committed to her quest for the purest honesty.
Sweet-tongued yet treacherous, she plays the game with a charming facade.
Before the embrace of death, let love's anguish be your guide, and hope's radiance be your inspiration.

Viola, a noble-born in distant lands, fell gravely ill ten years ago, diagnosed with a congenital anomaly.
The sickness robbed her of strength, forcing her to rely on an exoskeleton for minimal mobility. For a Felinian, absorbing Pathos Particles should have come naturally, but for Viola, it felt futile, as if they vanished into a void.
Once the epitome of perfection, Viola was brought to ruin but found the strength to rise anew.
—this transformation occurred on the twelfth night.
Naïve and childlike, yet elegant and aloof.
In the inferno's abyss, all souls stand equal.

Minotara, a formidable presence, claims dominion over the fallen realm of Egarudo, standing guard over the River Styx and the abyss as the Demon Lord. Once a saint who turned her back on her own people,\nshe embodies strength and honesty, guided by her own moral compass, dispensing justice as she sees fit.\nMuch like her emblem, the "Total Eclipse," she is viewed as a harbinger of disaster and ill omens, casting a shadow of foreboding. Symbolizing the darkness that obscures the sun, the occurrences of total and annular eclipses reflect the contentious nature of her existence. Just as the views on an eclipse vary, so too do opinions about her character among observers.
Scorn for constraints, swift and determined in action.
Agony is all I've ever known, yet it is also my lifeline, the force that keeps me anchored to existence... Without this suffering, I'd have no connection to the world at all.

Loco, known as the "Human Killer," has built a reputation for mercilessly tormenting and killing humans.
Once a guardian of an ancient Felinian tribe, she led a peaceful life until human greed and brutality led to the destruction of her homeland and the extinction of her kind.
Since that fateful day, she has transformed into a "demon," offering the blood of humans as a grim tribute to her fallen kin.
Little do many know that beneath her frenzied actions lies a flicker of her former innocence.
Perhaps it is this lingering innocence that allows her to glimpse another side of humanity in the Inspector amidst her sea of animosity...
Maybe that is the true vision of humanity she secretly cherishes.
Gentle in speech, yet unpredictably ruthless.
The luster of dreams outshines even the brightest gold.

Flashbulbs are her altar, breaking news her addiction. Meet Claire—a passionate young journalist working for a... let's say, 'struggling' tabloid known as The Leopard Daily.\nDespite her privileged upbringing, she refuses to lean on family connections, determined to forge her own path in the ruthless world of media. Undeterred by numerous rejections stemming from her lack of formal training, Claire never backs down. Now the paper's lone field reporter, she's convinced that she alone can save it—chasing every mundane lead with unflagging enthusiasm.\n"Come on, let's uncover a real headline!"
Sometimes, the best way to spend a day like this is by doing absolutely nothing.

Many might not realize that the photography and editing genius known as "Ms. Lulu" is, at her core, a devoted homebody.\nShe lives by the motto, "If I can stay in, I will," finding comfort in her newsroom, which serves as both her office and her refuge. Unless Claire drags her out for assignments, she prefers to let her trusty drone, SAVE, handle the mundane aspects of daily life.\n"Ahhh, all done! Now it's time for some well-deserved relaxation."
Where the night is darkest, there I stand as the lighthouse.

As the night envelops Florette Row, she steps into the scene with elegance, illuminated by the colorful neon lights that adorn her city. Her lips curl into a slight smile, revealing bright teeth and warm eyes, giving her an inviting presence, yet her demeanor carries an unmistakable air of authority and power.
Rosamund, the shadowy ruler of Florette Row and the head of the Ravens, walks the line between light and darkness.
Yet, when she locks eyes with the Inspector, a hint of gentleness softens her otherwise sharp expression—her unwavering determination and composure evoke memories of her beloved family.
"It's a pleasure to meet you this evening, young luminary... Care to join me for a drink?"
You'd be surprised how effective sleep is at dodging your problems.

From a young age, Zoe was thrust into the role of a familial tool, sent to the Forbidden Zone where she was gifted with the extraordinary ability of "Touch of Omniscience."
To make sense of everything she encountered, she became an unyielding machine—constantly reading, studying, sensing, and analyzing without rest.
The relentless tide of information crashed over her like an unending wave, gradually eroding her consciousness. Only in the brief moments of sleep could she escape this ceaseless onslaught.
Now, having fled the Forbidden Zone to take on the role of nominal Editor-in-Chief at the Leopard Daily, she still grapples with an insatiable craving for sleep. Yet, she quips,
"If there's chocolate involved, I might just be tempted to extend my work session for a few more minutes."
Too detached to care, too kind to ignore
Take up your weapon and serve, or lay down your armor and till the fields—there is always a path, always something to be done.

Originally named Sept, Savanna was sold to Cloud City, only to be abandoned by her foster parents and left to fend for herself on a snow-capped mountain. She was later taken in by Jul, the kind-hearted Darkrift.
Given a second chance to return to Cloud City, Savanna cast off her former name and joined the Divine Guards, eventually rising to become the youngest commander of Yunzhou.
However, the tragic death of Jul at the hands of a rogue Darkrift companion weighs heavily on her heart.
Despite the hardships she's faced, Savanna presses on with unwavering courage and a deep love for the world, determined to protect her beautiful home and its people.
Amicable, unwaveringly loyal, and deadly decisive.
Journey through life with a keen awareness of your inner self; cut through all afflictions and let go of your ego—this is the path of cultivation I follow.

Tara is an unconventional cultivator. Rather than relying on traditional meditation and introspection, she embarks on journeys to discover a path that resonates with her heart. Whether she's doing handstands, bungee jumping, or taking on spicy food challenges, Tara always finds a way to transform her experiences into a form of spiritual practice.\nWhen asked about her progress, she simply smiles and replies, "The essence of cultivation lies within the heart, and I still have a long journey ahead."
Full of life and energy, and deeply curious.
Yes, every day is a lucky day!

Fon is a child blessed by the Goddess of Luck.
Her extraordinary fortune sets her apart in a family that cherishes luck, allowing her every step to be smooth sailing—an experience most can only dream of.
However, the very thread of fate that elevates her also binds her with invisible chains.
Determined not to be confined by a life of ease, Fon strives to use her courage as a quill, sketching the boundaries of existence...
Until she can soar beyond the limits of fate.
Brave and optimistic, with endless energy to spare.
When someone comes to me in their time of need—that's when my life feels truly worthwhile.

As the heart and soul of the Stray Cat Shelter, Anna's days are a whirlwind of responsibilities: pushing paperwork, making rounds, and looking after the kids. But if she suddenly disappears? Check the couch—you'll probably find her buried in cat-shaped pillows, soda in hand, sneaking snacks and fully committed to "low-power mode."\nHer fingers idly brush over the bandage her sister stuck on her cheek as she watches the kids play. This time, she promises herself, she won't let the people she loves get hurt—not while she's around.\n"I'm the big sis around here. Got a problem? You come to me."
I've always believed misfortune follows me like a shadow, pushing people away. But I also know this: for those who truly care, that shadow fades into nothing.

Was it fate or a curse? Everyone around Marie seemed doomed to bad luck. Her own family, who boasted generations of good fortune, avoided her like bad news before finally kicking her out.
After that, she drifted through life as a hired blade, searching for somewhere—anywhere—to belong. Only when she stumbled into the Stray Cat Shelter and found people who genuinely cared did her streak of misfortune finally break.
Now she cradles this fragile happiness like a wounded bird, terrified it might fly away if she breathes wrong.
"So... you'll... come back soon, right...?"
I'll navigate fate itself, guided by the Overlord's name!

As a child, Erowyn's heightened sensitivity to Pathos Particles felt like a curse—until her parents gently encouraged her to see it as a heroic challenge. And so, the "Demon Overlord" was born: a self-proclaimed savior destined to master all dark Pathos!\nHer ambitious quest to "uncover the mastermind behind Pathos Particles" faced a setback during a science class on Pathos Technology... but nothing can shake her determination. Now, with a devoted army of cats as her loyal companions, she stands ready for action.\n"Verily, since it seems thou dost require mine aid so desperately, I shall deign to grant thee the privilege of mine own divine shelter."
Let me light the way to your dreams.

When the sea breeze carries her ethereal song, a summer festival born from wishes opens its doors to all.
She is the most compassionate listener, gently gathering every lost dream and humble prayer. She believes that every regret hidden deep in the heart deserves a chance to be mended, no matter the cost.
Yet, as she lights a beacon of hope for everyone, who will notice the wish she keeps buried, too afraid to reveal?
"Welcome to my festival, Investigator. Here, every wish will be heard... I hope, among your wishes... there is a place for me."
Gentle, kind, and longing for companionship
Truth doesn't fear being overturned—only being left untouched.

She oversees Catto City—the soul behind the E‑System, carrying centuries of memory. Beneath the white hair and gold eyes of her mechanical shell lies a mind in equal measure reason and madness. She once stood with her comrades to found Pathos Technology and build an ideal city where humans and Felinians coexist. She also lost herself to duty and power, and made unforgivable mistakes with her own hands. Even so, she never ducked responsibility. In the end, all the pain and pressure curl into a teasing smile at her lips. "Freedom without limits will destroy everything. If you need a cautionary tale, use me—keep everyone on guard. Don't worry, I don't charge. From now on, you get the final say on my story."
Quirky, quick-witted Bold, forward‑leaning, takes responsibility
If you run away even just once, it'll become a hard habit to break.

After "the incident," young Asura found herself pushed to the outskirts of her community.
She faced rejection, isolation, and cruelty,
but her independent spirit never faltered. Deep down, she knew the real story was being hidden, and she was determined to cut through the lies and uncover the truth buried by powerful forces.

Now, as a dedicated StormEye Combatant, she hones her skills through relentless training and nightly patrols, serving as a guardian who delivers justice with her blade.
Yet, she often wonders if she would have found the strength to take that crucial first step on her journey without the Inspector and her team by her side.
Daring and resolute, straightforward and pure.
No matter what happens, we'll move forward together.

Birdsong—sparrows, most likely—chattered through the morning hush and gently tugged her awake.
She opened her eyes. A white ceiling. Green blinds. Dawn light slipped through the slats, pooling warmly at her bedside. Color flooded in, vivid and bright, as if she were drifting through a beautiful dream.
Thump. Thump. Thump.
In her chest, her heart beat steady and calm.
Everything felt so ordinary. So warm.
So what would happen next? she found herself wondering.
"Haah..."
After one long, deep breath, she slowly pushed the door open and took her first step forward—
"Combatant Shiro, reporting back for duty…"
This world is steeped in corruption. I abandoned everything else, all for the sake of what I still call justice.

Ulthar was born from sorrow and flesh — a bloom nurtured in the wreckage of forbidden experiments. Once a victim of those obsessions, she rose as their consequence: consumed by the hunger for strength, and the dream of a dominion shaped in her own image.\nShe walks the world beneath countless names, haunting its shadows like a ghost, weaving fear into every corner of its web. For a fleeting moment she blazed, beautiful and terrifying, before dissolving into the stars — waiting for the next dawn to call her back. She never truly fades.\n"Don’t think. Give yourself to me—body, heart, and soul. I will grant you everything… and more."
To sink is not the worst fate. The worst is for no one to remember what you once lived for.

In the tidal civilization, Vingrakka is the Mourner reborn—she who chooses which heroic souls will rise again, guides them to the Necropolis of Heroes, and leads them home to the ancestral land.

She seldom fights. She keeps her solitary watch over the Necropolis, caring for her people and choosing those who must meet their end.

Now Pathos pollution is spreading fast. The ancestral land is sinking, and a catastrophe that will consume the entire planet draws near. When the God of Prophecy reborn receives the Prophet's oracle, Vingrakka sees doom already unfolding through the Prophet's eyes. To change her people's fate, she resolves to seek out the Warrior of Legend.

"I will walk at your side, even when the road ahead is lost to mist."
If anyone is beyond forgiveness, it's me. Still, I'll carry this guilt with me and keep moving forward.

Yui Ayaka is, by all appearances, an ordinary student. But the "Companion Spirit" that never leaves her side is no stranger—it is the lingering soul of her closest friend, Hina Shinonome.
Hina's resentment toward the online abuse she suffered twisted her into a vengeful spirit. Yet at heart, she was still far too kind to ever wish harm on anyone. Instead, she stayed by Yui's side in silence, carrying only one wish: that no one else would have to suffer the way she did.
Someday, as the incident fades from people's memories and the regrets binding her to this world are finally laid to rest, "Hina Shinonome" will likely disappear as well. Until that day comes, she continues to watch over Yui—quietly, faithfully, without a word.
"Want to walk home together tonight—?"
Kind and ordinary, yet timid and weak-willed.
Human stories always leave loose ends. Urban legends are no exception—but real anomalies leave none.

Rumor tells of a programmer at a major corporation: tireless at work, distant from others, and endlessly curious. She had a fascination with urban legends from the internet, collecting them obsessively and sharing them across forum after forum.
Then, little by little, people began receiving links from anonymous numbers. Each one led to a bare-bones anonymous chatroom—an app that could only be downloaded at certain times, and only on certain device models.
"She" believed that if enough emotions could be gathered in one place, they could give birth to a real "urban legend."
—"Welcome! Care to hear a new story?"
That was the message waiting inside the chatroom.
Curiosity-driven, willing to do whatever it takes.
The world suffers, and it is my duty to mend its wounds.

Having experienced her father's betrayal, Mara believed she would never encounter anything similar again.
But despite her sincerity and trust, she only received deep wounds in return.
Love tainted by dark desires between men and women became an inescapable thorn in Mara's heart.

The city is perpetually engulfed in filthy desires.
Deception, betrayal, scheming... the rich emotions of humanity inevitably become the breeding ground for sin. Struggling within the clutches of her Pathosis, Mara ultimately succumbed and became an Anomaly, tightly grasping a metal pipe, transforming into an "Extra-Judiciary Vigilante" dedicated to upholding justice in the city.

"I simply want to... exterminate them all."
I just want… to keep living with dignity.

During those days of humiliation, Notte naively believed that as long as he served faithfully like a loyal dog, all the painful experiences would serve as stepping stones towards climbing higher.
But the cruel disparities in rank reminded him that all his desires were nothing but illusions.

To survive, he had to make a change. Notte finally escaped the source of his nightmares, carrying the closely guarded secret techniques of the Akasuna family.
However, the Eden of his dreams did not embrace him with open arms—unceasing panic, the intense backlash of the secret techniques, threatening to tear him apart.

And it was at this moment that the enigmatic young man, perpetually adorned with a mysterious smile, appeared.
"I am willing to become... the Darkrift."

The unwavering aspiration in Sabre's life is to cultivate both body and mind, delve deep into the art of sabreplay, and strive for the pinnacle of martial skills.

The rumors of the "Roadblock Sabre" continue to circulate throughout Catto City, but these external disturbances do not distract Sabre from his arduous training.
He silently traverses the roads where formidable foes may emerge, patiently awaiting the moment when the cold glimmer of his blade lights up his undisturbed eyes.

Thrilling battles between warriors are what he yearns for the most.
All of you, vanish into thin air!

Artificial "monsters" do not dream of electric sheep.

In the stagnant, seemingly endless span of ten years, within Ozul's recurring dreams, there exist only sterile, repulsive laboratories adorned in pure white, and the excruciating pain that rends his soul apart.
The towering syringe, razor-sharp scalpels, and the blinding white glow of the shadowless lamp... they form the tapestry of his nightmares.

He knows that only "that person" can redeem him, bringing darkness and fleeting tranquility.
Therefore, anything or anyone that obstructs that person or betrays him will face the swing of Ozul's colossal hammer, meeting their demise.

He lives for him, willingly sacrificing himself,
like offering his life to a comforting abyss.
A life without change is the most dull of all! Let's stir things up a little!

The sudden loss of his daughter is the most agonizing memory in Jester's brief "human" life.
He pleaded, prayed, and wept, but those tender and warm hands will never exist again.

Since that fateful day, he has become known as "the walking dead."
Worldly happiness holds no significance for him; not even the most absurd clown performance can elicit a smile. He yearns, he despises, he jealously envies those who have intact families, and the dark impulse within his heart relentlessly seeks revenge.

Someone entices him, tantalizingly saying, "Join us, become the Darkrift. You have nothing to lose, do you?"
Jester does not hesitate.

Most of the time, Ealy is the most dependable brother. He navigates the narrow alleyways, ensuring absolute victory in conflicts, making him an indisputable force to be reckoned with.

Every day, he forcefully suppresses the explosive impulses in his heart, until the final remaining support becomes the fuse of the explosion, and the defection of "Wind," "Forest," and "Mountain" becomes the spark that ignites the inferno.
"Will you never betray me? Then let me put it to the test!"

He confronts the enemy head-on, his skateboard ablaze with fierce flames. It is a warning, a provocation, and a roar from within his heart.
There are always innocent bystanders, but at this moment, he is not one of them.

If nothing unexpected happens, Elaine's childhood should have been filled with the embrace and love of her parents.
However, after her father left, her mother, who single-handedly supported the family, also suffered from severe Pathosis.
Sweet candies, beautiful dresses, graceful dance steps, and gentle lullabies... all of these gradually vanished from Elaine's life.

In the face of life's pressures, Elaine swiftly matured in ignorance.
Moreover, there was that kind uncle dressed in a rabbit doll costume, promising to save her and all the lonely and helpless children like her.

She is willing to believe once again.

Before turning into a terrifying and repulsive Anomaly, the Bun Bun, like many other dolls of various shapes, was once a hero guarding children by their pillows.

It was awakened by the sadness and anger of its "abandoned" master, and as the master disappeared, it became the one that was "abandoned."
The Pathos Particles fermented in the derelict factory, and the long wait granted Bun Bun the ability to control other dolls. But what truly brought it joy was being able to speak for itself, finally telling a story to its master before bedtime, replacing the forever busy mother.

It slumbered in anticipation, until another girl opened the factory doors.
Life is a continuous ascent, conquering peak after peak!

Before accumulating enough capital, "dignity" was merely a constraint that hindered Jack Roy's progress.

Wealth and fame are like waves that can either engulf people in the abyss or become excellent driving forces that compel them to keep moving forward.
The whole world eagerly pursues them, and Jack Roy believes he possesses enough strategies and skills to make Jack Trading Company the envy of thousands.

The past of struggling with wild dogs for food, fighting bullies, and wrestling in the mud constantly reminds him that he will never, ever fall again.
The pinnacle is right in front of him. Sadly, people are always deceived by fate.

The corners without sunshine and laughter are the breeding grounds of evil. Pathos Particles filled with fear and panic are the most delectable nourishment.

As a special existence among Anomalies, the Reaper never tires of causing chaos with his own hands.
He always whispers secretly to the victims, inciting wicked thoughts, eradicating kindness, and sowing "seeds" of evil in the hearts of innocent people. And one day, when it surpasses the moral limit, it will take root and sprout in the dark soil.

"Hehe, yes, that's right... the Reaper is coming to harvest."
I shall witness that incredibly beautiful world on your behalf.

Everything is driven by vengeance.

No matter how perfect the story may be, no matter how delightful the food, it cannot assuage Vencent's despondency.
He cannot forgive himself for the decision to send his child into the tower with his own hands, a grievous mistake that condemns him to a lifetime of unending anguish.

But when he picked up the rabbit doll in a suit, a long-lost sense of joy enveloped his being.
I will seek out more children with the qualifications of the Darkrift, for only their power can overthrow the entirety of Catto City!

"We shall prevail, we shall triumph."
The footsteps of the Rabbit Doll Legion march in perfect order and unity. Vencent willingly becomes one of them.
In paradise, you will find rebirth.

For Carol, every subsequent decision she made was an attempt to atone for her past mistakes.

She despised herself for readily giving away trust and regretted burying the once peaceful and happy life with her own hands.
Thus, in gentle persuasion, in cunning manipulation, in witnessing the hopeful eyes of the children, what she truly resented was her former self as a "mother" who failed to cherish herself.

"Come with me to that paradise devoid of pain and regret..."
Carol uttered those same words countless times, their tones etched into memory. But... what has transpired cannot be undone.

The warrior awakens from ignorance, clad in armor. The passage of time and the rust on his blades cannot impede his progress.
As a true warrior, he harbors no desire for senseless slaughter, only an unwavering determination to strive and compete.

To seek the strong, vanquish the strong, and become strong.
Such is his unyielding aspiration.
The screen serves as the perfect disguise.

Syer was born on an ordinary factory assembly line.
As a meticulously packaged birthday gift, he once believed he would lead a carefree life, cherished and valued.
However, the day inevitably arrived when his performance waned, his edges dulled, and his shell became marred with scratches.
The rapid obsolescence of electronic products is astounding, and he becomes outdated.

He knew he had irrevocably lost his owner's attention, but this sense of loss paled in comparison to the agony inflicted by the owner's corruption. How could such a vibrant and optimistic young person now associate with the sordid online realm?
"In that case, let us... destroy together!"

A family held together by a sole anchor will crumble in an instant when that anchor dissipates.
After losing her mother, the cold closet became Nao's second "home."

When will this dark and despairing existence come to an end?
The girl curled up, weeping until Triss's gentle voice rekindled her long-forgotten courage.

The antithesis of cold is passion. Nao throws herself unhesitatingly onto the path of pursuing Triss, supporting her every move with a glow stick in hand.
"Triss, you're the light in my life...!"

But can that faint light truly redeem her?
Just hold on a little longer...

Mitri, buried under an overwhelming workload, often forgets that she is truly alive in this world.

Bonuses and vacations always remain as elusive promises, and only the piercing pain in her heart relentlessly reminds her of the harsh reality that her vitality is slowly diminishing.
Almost there, soon she can rest—Mitri reassures herself, barely sustaining her vitality with medication.

But setbacks seem to follow one after another...

"Beep..."
Perhaps someone will stumble upon a lost phone in a deserted alley. As for the owner, who really cares?
The right answer lies along the path I pursue.

There is an absolute "answer" to every question.

Whether it's a rigorous scientific theory or the unforgiving choices of fate
—through logical deduction, data verification, and methodologies that may already exist or are yet to be understood, West firmly believes that he will find and forever tread upon the "correct" path.

The teacher's cane corrects "erroneous" answers, and thunder shatters the theoretical foundations that fail to deduce the "correct" result. All the "answers" distorted by fate will be reevaluated... Until that moment, the path leading to truth will once again be connected, and pure white tranquility will be restored by his side.
Is it sinful to yearn for freedom?

Chautrand has lived his entire life under the scrutiny of others. The strictness of his parents acts as shackles, the deaths of his friends as guilt-inducing nails, and every gesture from the audience feels like mockery.

Expensive pianos, waterlogged guitars, blood that stains...

The true past is an ultimate nightmare. In every agonizing day and night, his body and mind bleed, all for the person who gave his life meaning, to sing the unsung song.
Life is destined to fade, and memories will be distorted by time, but... on that afternoon, the free soul trembling under the sunlight is always within reach, yet so far away.

"Don't... look at... me...!"
Whenever it may be, I will give my all.

Someone once said she is like a rose.
Beautiful, strong, always quietly blooming, as if able to overcome all hardships.
She wraps herself in thorns to protect the tenderness hidden within her heart.
It is her weapon to guard her true self and the barrier she erects against this cruel world.
Perhaps that's why Black Tea can break through the thorns of fate and radiate her own brilliance.
"My gun exists to protect someone dear to me."
Whenever it may be, I will give my all.

She wraps herself in thorns to protect the tenderness hidden within her heart.
It is her weapon to guard her true self and the barrier she erects against this cruel world.
Perhaps that's why Black Tea can break through the thorns of fate and radiate her own brilliance.
"My gun exists to protect someone dear to me."

Like a pink snowflake silently falling in the spring breeze, the girl awakens amidst a blooming peach forest. She possesses nothing except her name, but in her heart, there is an indistinct thought engraved.
There is someone she has always wanted to meet.
That person is the warm sun that melts the snow, the only light she had during her slumber in darkness.
"Finally, I get to meet you, Inspector,"
she says with a smile after a long wait and endless anticipation.
My master is my absolute favorite!

Chocola is a forthright, canine-natured catgirl who deeply adores her master.
She and her twin sister, Vanilla, are the youngest among the catgirls in the Minazuki household.
She may not excel at pondering complex matters, but her perpetually cheerful and lovable nature wins the hearts of all.
Her drive is exceptionally high. Once she gets an idea, she springs into action without any delay.
Overall, despite occasional moments of confusion, her diligent nature makes her endearing to everyone.
Bright and spirited, exuding an approachable warmth.
Chocola is the most adorable catgirl.

Vanilla is a gentle, clever, and quiet catgirl who especially adores Chocola.
She and her twin sister Chocola are the youngest among the catgirls in the Minazuki household.
Her quiet nature often leads to misunderstandings, but she is actually very perceptive and intelligent.
Her personality is the complete opposite of Chocola's, as she is independent and agile in her actions.
In truth, she is deeply loyal and truly embodies the essence of a cat.
Subtle and sharp, exhibiting a clever and agile intellect.
I wish to be with everyone forever, never to be separated.

Cacao, with her composed demeanor, cherishes the company of Chocola and Vanilla.
Spotted by Chocola during an errand, she was welcomed into La Soleil, where she now shares life with Chocola and Vanilla.
Although she may appear quiet and reserved, she is actually sharp-eyed, observant, and highly active.
Being grateful by nature, she deeply values the kindness of those around her.
In times of need, she will rise to protect her friends and the community.
Serene and contemplative, with a keen observational skill.
